newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee ends flat despite import covering.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee ends flat despite import covering.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed unmoved against the dollar on Tuesday despite some commerciald demand, due to the market being well offered with the greenback, dealers said.
The rupee closed at its opening level of 58.62 to the dollar, they said.
"The rupee was unmoved despite some import covering, because the market was well offered with dollars," said a Standard Chartered Bank dealer.
Overnight call money closed at its opening level of nine percent.
